text:
olivia: Quick async status + a couple asks on the SDK migration + v2 deprec rollout. TL;DR: canary tomorrow AM, SDK ref bump planned for next Tuesday, need infra + owners to confirm capacity and flag gating.

olivia: Current plan:
- Today: freeze new API surface for v2 rollout (docs + changelog final)
- Tomorrow 09:00 PT: canary traffic (5%) to v2 endpoints in us-west
- Tue: SDK minor bump (client v1.9 -> v2.0-rc) published to npm/pypi for early adopters
- Wed: start 25% traffic if smoke passes

raj: ack, canary window works for infra. just need the exact endpoint names we'll route so proxy rules can be added.

olivia: good point — endpoints are: /v1/generate (legacy) -> will be routed to v2-compatible shim; new model endpoint: /v2/generate. We'll add header gating: `x-rw-api-version: 2` or query param `?api_version=2`.

kevin: owning proxy changes. i'll add a proxy rule PR this afternoon. ping me when you cut the canary flag.

maria: on SDK side: the bump includes a breaking change to the request body (metadata flattened). I'll push a migration guide with examples. tagging @kevin because SDK tests rely on proxy mock urls.

sam: testing note — we have an e2e job that runs against the staging proxy. after kevin's PR lands, can we run the smoke suite against the canary slice? I can wire it to run at 08:30 PT tomorrow.

olivia: yes please — schedule smoke at 08:30 PT, canary at 09:00 PT. sam, can you also add a quick post-check that verifies token propagation and latency SLO (p95 < 220ms)?

sam: will do. adding a short job: `./scripts/smoke.sh --slice=canary --checks=token,latency`

ci-bot: CI pipeline scheduled: `e2e-canary-staging` will run on merge of proxy PR and on SDK rc publish.

deploy-bot: Reminder: deploy window tomorrow 08:45-10:30 PT. If rollback needed, tag `canary-roll-<timestamp>` and ops will revert routing.

raj: one dependency: eng-infra needs to ensure we have the extra 2 GPU hosts enabled in us-west for the canary model. ops ticket INF-534 created.

kevin: noted. i'll reference INF-534 in the proxy PR.

maria: SDK migration guide draft: https://short.link/sdk-migration-draft — includes examples, changelog, and a snippet for the new header:```json
{
  "model": "redwood-open/fast-1",
  "input": "...",
  "metadata": {
    "request_id": "string"
  }
}```

olivia: thanks. final asks:
1) kevin — PR with proxy rule + feature flag check in proxy by EOD?
2) raj — confirm infra hosts by EOD or update INF-534
3) maria — publish migration guide + SDK rc to npm/pypi by EOD so early testers can opt-in
4) sam — smoke job scheduled and post-checks added for 08:30 PT tomorrow

kevin: i can do the PR now, will ping when created.

raj: infra will try to confirm, i put a note on INF-534 for the owners.

maria: publishing RC now to test pypi/npm — will post links when available.

sam: smoke job added and configured. will post results in this thread once it runs.

olivia: perfect. if anything blocks EOD, drop a short reply here. otherwise i'll cut the canary flag tomorrow morning and post a short rollout summary. :thumbsup:
